newsitem.title: USA: Navigation Tech says wins court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Navigation Tech says wins court ruling.

text.p: Navigation Technologies Corp said Tuesday a federal court in California had ruled in favor of Zexel Corp and NavTech in a patent suit filed in 1994 by Etak Inc.
Etak had alleged Zexel's USA route guidance system, NavMate, infringed two Etak patents, NavTech said.
In 1995 NavTech, the database supplier to Zexel, filed claims against Etak seeking declaration that Etak's patents were invalid, unenforceable and not infringed by Zexel's system, it said.
In January 1997 Zexel and NavTech filed four summary judgment motions asserting non-infringement and patent invalidity, the company said.
On March 31, the court denied all of Etak's motions and partially granted all of Zexel's and NavTech's motions, NavTech said.
Some claims still remained in dispute, it said.
Sony Corp's U.S. unit agreed to buy Etak, a developer of digital map data, from News Corp last year.
